Badge semantic colors use fixed rgba values — no theme dependency

Component styles fully specified (card, data_row, badge, section_header, metric, progress_bar)
Animation tokens with exact durations and easing curves

Panel integration pattern confirmed: standalone panels reusing existing hooks
